summary.text: On the plane of Lorwyn and Shadowmoor, the Great Aurora turns the constantly sunny Lorwyn into Shadowmoor, a world of perpetual night, where Ashling becomes the destructive Extinguisher while Rhys, Maralen and Brigid Baeli are caught between Oona and the faeries.
Oona tries to take Ashling's elemental power and drains the elves of Cayr Ulios until Gryffid sacrifices himself to weaken her hold.
Maralen and Ashling's elemental power, with the sacrifice of the Sapling of Colfenor, finally defeat Oona at Glen Elendra, and Maralen becomes queen of the fae as day returns.
